model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for different language families across various model configurations. The horizontal axis represents language family, with categories labeled “IE-Baltic,” “IE-Germanic,” “IE-Indic,” “IE-Romance,” “IE-Slavic,” “IE-other,” “Isolate,” “Semitic,” and “Uralic,” presented in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “effect,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5. For each language family, there is a grouped set of six bars representing different model configurations: mBERT-L2 (blue), XLM-L2 (red), mBERT-R2 (green), XLM-R2 (dark gray), mBERT-B2 (light green), and XLM-B2 (brown). Each bar also includes an error bar extending above and below it. The height of the bars varies significantly; for example, for “IE-Baltic”, the mBERT-L2 bar is approximately 8, while the mBERT-R2 bar is around 11. In contrast, for "Semitic," the mBERT-L2 bar reaches around 28. The chart does not appear to be sorted by any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
